issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite TDD requiring tests for every feature including failure and authorization paths.
Ticket::call authorizes with a direct EntityMembership query instead of a policy/gate as conventions require.
Unique-violation check tests the same 23000 code twice with and without a string cast.
Catching InactiveQueueException only to rethrow it is unnecessary since it would not be caught by the QueryException handler.
Models use the #[Fillable] attribute rather than the $fillable property named by the conventions; confirm the installed Laravel version supports it.

conventions.evidence: Domain write uses app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:20; migrations have reversible down() at database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_queues_table.php:28 and 000002:73; docs/business-rules.md:485 and docs/database-schema.md updated; BUT diff has zero tests/** files (TDD: no production code without a test); app/Models/Ticket.php:291-293 authorizes via direct EntityMembership query, not a policy/gate

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods, PHPDoc on app/Models/Ticket.php:255 and :280; nits at app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:68 duplicate (e->getCode() === '23000') check and app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:54-55 redundant catch-rethrow

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:39 lockForUpdate re-read + :41 is_active reject, :27 negative priority InvalidArgumentException, :57 retry on unique collision; app/Models/Ticket.php:261-278 nextCode last-valid-by-id handles A999->A1000=>A1001, deletion no-reuse, A-X skipped; :234-242 write-once LogicException with status/called_at/called_by_user_id/updated_at allowed; :287-307 call() member-only AuthorizationException + non-waiting LogicException; migrations have cascade FKs, unique (queue_id,code), index (queue_id,status,priority,issued_at); enums, InactiveQueueException, Queue/Entity::queues, factories with forQueue all match contract

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php, app/Enums/*, app/Exceptions/InactiveQueueException.php, app/Models/Queue.php + Ticket.php + Entity.php:130 queues(), database/factories/*, two migrations, docs/business-rules.md + docs/database-schema.md; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:27 priority validated, :39-43 queue locked and re-checked server-side; app/Models/Ticket.php:291-297 membership checked before mutation throws AuthorizationException with ticket unchanged, :299 status check; explicit #[Fillable] lists at app/Models/Queue.php:14 and app/Models/Ticket.php:201; no Blade/Livewire output or secrets

simplicity.evidence: Lean change: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php 71 lines with small isUniqueViolation helper; app/Models/Ticket.php:261 nextCode is a simple id-ordered scan with no speculative abstraction; factories delegate code allocation to Ticket::creating; no service/repository layers

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/**, no Pest files and no weakened tests to inspect; issuance, nextCode edges (A999/A1000, deletion, A-X), write-once LogicException, and call authorization paths are all untested

review.summary: Implements the full queue/ticket domain core correctly including nextCode edges, locked-row inactive check with retry, write-once and single-call rules. No tests ship with the change, which blocks merging under the TDD convention; remaining notes are minor convention and readability nits.
